claims.disproof_condition: NVIDIA or Lumentum discloses termination/expiry of the purchase commitment, or NVIDIA discloses sourcing its advanced laser components primarily from other vendors.
claims.statement: Customer-side confirmation: NVIDIA is investing $2B in Lumentum and the nonexclusive agreement includes an NVIDIA multibillion purchase commitment plus future capacity access rights for advanced laser components — client-side (origin NVIDIA) evidence of the Lumentum-to-NVIDIA laser/optics supply relationship, symmetric to the Coherent deal of the same day.

source_doc.permission_basis: Corporate press release intended for public distribution; brief quotations stored in library/raw and this extraction.
source_doc.title: NVIDIA PR: NVIDIA Announces Strategic Partnership With Lumentum to Develop State-of-the-Art Optics Technology

sources.quote: NVIDIA is investing $2 billion in Lumentum to support R&D, future capacity and operations as the company builds out its U.S.-based manufacturing capabilities in a new fab.
The nonexclusive agreement includes an NVIDIA multibillion purchase commitment and future capacity access rights for advanced laser components.
high-performance lasers, modules, and optical subsystems that enable scalable, energy-efficient data center connectivity
Together with Lumentum, NVIDIA is advancing the world's most sophisticated silicon photonics to build the next generation of gigawatt-scale AI factories.

sources.locator: PR body, opening paragraph（NVIDIA 宣布與 Lumentum 簽多年合約）
sources.quote: NVIDIA today announced multiyear strategic agreements with Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: LITE) to accelerate innovation in advanced optics technologies, including research and development, to enable next-generation AI infrastructure and systems designs.
